d: Company Description Apollo Hospitals Sultanate of Oman, located in Muscat, is a 60-bed multi-specialty hospital that strengthens the healthcare infrastructure in the region. The hospital is committed to setting new benchmarks in quality and safety in healthcare delivery. Apollo emphasizes innovation, continuous improvement, and introspection to enhance clinical care and patient experience. The team focuses on compassionate, patient-centered services that align with international standards. Healthcare professionals joining Apollo Hospitals are supported by modern facilities and a culture of excellence.

Role Description The Neonatal Intensive Care Unit (NICU) Nurse is a full-time, on-site role based in Muscat. This role involves providing specialized nursing care to critically ill and high-risk newborns, including ongoing assessment, monitoring vital signs, administering medications, and supporting life-sustaining therapies as per medical orders and protocols. The NICU Nurse collaborates closely with neonatologists, pediatricians, and other healthcare professionals to develop, implement, and evaluate individualized care plans. Daily responsibilities include maintaining accurate clinical documentation, ensuring adherence to infection control and safety standards, and educating and supporting families on newborn care, conditions, and treatment plans. The role also entails participating in clinical rounds, quality improvement initiatives, and continuing education activities to maintain high standards of neonatal care.
q: Valid nursing license/registration and completion of an accredited Nursing program (Bachelor’s degree in Nursing or equivalent preferred).
Demonstrated clinical experience in neonatal or pediatric intensive care, with strong skills in assessment, monitoring, and evidence-based nursing interventions.
Knowledge of NICU equipment and procedures, such as ventilators, infusion pumps, incubators, and neonatal resuscitation techniques (NRP certification an advantage).
Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to provide clear, compassionate support and education to families and collaborate effectively within multidisciplinary teams.
Commitment to patient safety, infection prevention, and adherence to clinical protocols, with good organizational and time-management abilities.
Willingness to work shifts, including nights, weekends, and holidays, and to participate in ongoing professional development and training.
Experience in a tertiary care or multi-specialty hospital setting and familiarity with international healthcare standards are beneficial.

d: Seeking an experienced, data-driven growth marketer to help 8 countries achieving Quick Commerce (QC) success on Talabat platforms. The User Growth marketing senior specialist will oversee the development, management and execution of marketing campaigns that help countries understand and adopt strategies that will improve budget efficiency in all user lifecycles while not compromising on growth potential.
Campaign Lifecycle Management: Own each stage of the growth campaign lifecycle - ideation, execution, performance analysis, and iteration, ensuring continuous improvement with every cycle.

CRM & Performance Marketing Ownership: Own the CRM and performance marketing strategy for the region, setting the direction across channels (push, email, SMS, paid social, programmatic, SEM, etc.) and ensuring they work together as one coherent growth engine rather than in silos. Balance channel-level strategy with overall budget efficiency and consistency of customer experience.

Experimentation & Testing: Design and analyze A/B tests and experiments across campaigns and incentive strategies. Define hypotheses, success metrics, and minimum sample sizes. Interpret results and translate findings into actionable next steps.

Marketing Strategy Support: Contribute to the development of regional marketing strategies by conducting market analysis, benchmarking, and building business cases for new opportunities. Help define scope and gain cross-functional alignment for initiatives tailored to each country's growth stage.
Incentive Strategy: Lead the consumer incentive front by developing and executing tailored strategies based on market trends, competitive dynamics, and customer segmentation.

Data Analysis & Dashboards: Build, maintain, and interpret growth dashboards to inform campaign decisions and report on performance. Deep-dive into data to uncover insights, and translate them into clear recommendations for leadership and country teams.

Operational Excellence: Design and implement scalable workflows for campaign execution, from brief to launch, that reduce manual effort and improve turnaround time. Build reusable templates, playbooks, and automation where possible to optimize the balance between growth impact and speed of delivery.

Knowledge Management & Best Practices: Serve as the team's point of contact for evolving growth playbooks and best practices. Document changes, train cross-functional partners, and ensure new approaches are adopted in live campaigns.
At least 5 years of professional experience, with hands-on background in marketing channels, consulting, or finance
A passion for data and comfort with numbers, coupled with experience in quantitative data analysis, measurable insights, and experiments. Proficiency in SQL is a plus
Proven experience managing multiple marketing channels, with solid working knowledge of CRM and performance marketing channels and how they fit together in a full-funnel strategy.
Demonstrate ability to build and optimize rigorous processes, finding scalable solutions and championing operational excellence
Customer-centric mindset, thriving in a fast-paced environment, and comfortable working with multiple stakeholders
